name: Present simple vs. continuous
note: Present simple for habits, routines and permanent facts (I work in a bank; water boils at 100°). Present continuous (am/is/are + -ing) for things happening now or around now, and fixed future arrangements (I'm working late today). Stative verbs (know, like, want, believe) are normally not continuous.

questions.q: I ______ lots of books every year.
The relative humidity usually ______ when the temperature goes down.
questions.fs: The relative humidity usually falls when the temperature goes down.
